title: Chapter 504
paragraphs: Chapter 504
Episode 139. Threat (3)
The group quietly drew their swords. Due to the hazy sandstorm, they couldn't quickly identify who the opponent was.
The figure approaching from a distance showed no signs of being intimidated. This fact made the group slightly uneasy.
"...It doesn't seem to be a Zifel. They haven't fired a signal flare right away."
Joshua spoke in a low voice. As he said, if it had been a Zifel, the figure would have fired a signal flare as soon as they saw the Runecandels.
The distance between the group and the figure gradually closed.

"Oh, the second generation indeed has excellent situational assessment skills? But that person's back... a sword? Isn't it a bit too big to be a sword? It's also an odd shape. I think I've heard of someone using such a weapon. Whose story was it?"
A sword that was ignorantly large and crude in shape.
"Ah! Big sister! That's right, our big sister, White Scenery, uses that weapon, right?"
A weapon that could be called an ax rather than a sword. Luna Runecandel was the only person in the world who used that weapon.
At least until recently.
Jin and Murakan had recently encountered a person who wielded Luna's signature axe-sword like a toy at the Black King's mine.
'No way...!'
'Damn, that crazy dragon?'
Both of them recalled the memory of that day at the same time, and the other Runecandels had no idea who the figure was. It couldn't be Luna.
Soon, the group could face the figure's face.
A beautiful white face that seemed to shine even in the sandstorm, a slender physique that seemed strange to carry the axe-sword.
The Devil Dragon, Zephilin.
"Wow, Jin and Black Dragon Murakan. What a coincidence! I didn't expect to meet you here!"
Sandra was the first to react to Zephilin's appearance.
"Uh, who are you? Are you close to Jin?"
"Hm? Ah, Sandra Zifel? What are you going to do if we're close?"
"If we're very close, I'll treat you as a sister or as a cute younger one."
Murakan poked Sandra's shoulder. Sandra, who had been dubious, began to ignite hostility with a clear indication that they were not that close.
"I almost made a mistake. You're pretending to be close for no reason, you ragged thing."
"Oh my, you have a sharp tongue. Trusting half-immortality and being disrespectful could lead you to your doom, you know? Ms. Living Golem."
"Huh? Shall we see who dies first, me or you?"
"You're cute. Did becoming a living golem also cause some problems in your head?"
Seeing Zephilin speak with a lively smile reminded Jin and Murakan of their difficult fight that day.
- The leader of Kinzelo, I think it might be their dragon.
- That unpleasant bastard? It's possible. The power he showed during the Gumpwangseong terrorist attack was divine.
- ...Murakan and the 12th generation, if the fight drags on, I don't think there's an answer.
- No answer if it drags on? That's an understatement. We can't win against that.
They never expected to face Zephilin after getting out of Hedo. It was like going from one mountain to another.
'If it had been another time, there really wouldn't have been a solution.'
But not now. In Jin's possession were the purposes Zephilin had come for.
Joshua, Diphus, and Jane still couldn't figure out who Zephilin was, but they could tell she was extraordinary.
It was because Murakan wasn't showing any intention to fight, just bluntly saying the outcome.
In fact, Murakan was itching to fight to the point of going crazy, but he was holding back because fighting Zephilin now could kill Jin.
It wasn't just about facing Zephilin. If they fought her, Zifel's pursuit squad would inevitably join the battle, and Kinzelo's troops, including Grunil, could also follow.

In Murakan's stead, Sandra was continuously pouring curses and insults without a break. They were terrible words that even the worst thugs in the back alleys would shun, making one wonder where she had learned them.
And Jin was secretly relieved in his heart.
'Fortunately, it's as I expected.'
Just as the other Runecandels were reading the atmosphere from Murakan's attitude,
Jin was assessing the situation through Zephilin's actions.
'The ship blueprints and machines in the 2nd Magic Tower vault are indeed important to Kinzelo.'
It had already been proven by the resources and manpower Kinzelo had invested, but Zephilin's actions made it even more certain.
The Zephilin Jin remembered was not someone who talked first when there was a problem. Her style was to stab her opponent without any prelude or warning.
But now, she was talking like this, narrowing her eyes.
"Well, I don't think we need a long conversation. I can't stand the quacking voice of that living golem anymore. Jin, hand over the things you stole from the vault."
"What if I refuse?"
"Then you'll all be annihilated. By my hands. Are you curious about something so obvious?"
At the word 'annihilation,' the other Runecandels felt humiliation once again. Both Hedo, who they had just fought, and the woman in front of them were looking down on the Runecandels.
But they had no other choice.
Being 'weak' was just that. As a pure-blooded Runecandel who became a generation, they had never tasted humiliation, let alone consecutive humiliations, like today.
As the brothers gritted their teeth, the smile Jin had been hiding inside grew even deeper.
'I've almost won.'
In terms of pure strength, he might not know, but the situation, conditions, and everything were turning in his favor.
'Jephyrin had no intention of killing me in the Black King Mine either. Probably because killing me would cause problems in obtaining Soldelet's contract.'
Then it was the same now.
Unless Kinzello had made some special progress in the meantime, Jephyrin still couldn't kill Jin.
And this place was the Lutero Magic Federation, near Drakka. If a fight started and Kinzello and Zieffel flocked to fight over Jin.

The likelihood of Zieffel, not Kinzello, capturing Jin in some way was very high. In that case, not only would they lose the items, but they would also lose Jin, which would be a huge loss for Kinzello.
"Annihilation? You're talking too easily, Jephyrin."
"Do you think I can't?"
"Yeah."
"Seems like you're so confident because you believe I won't kill you easily after letting my guard down last time, but I'm not in a good mood today."
Murakan had assessed that he could never beat Jephyrin at the time, and she seemed unable to use all her power for some reason as well.
In the Black King Mine, Jephyrin eventually left the battlefield without any gain. It was because she had suffered unexpected damage from Tess's power.
'She might not have fully recovered from the blow she received then.'
He couldn't jump to conclusions, but his intuition was telling him.
It wouldn't be a problem to be more aggressive.
"So what do you want? Are you begging me to cater to your mood while whining?"
"Are you going to be uncooperative until the end? Ah, you must believe that I won't kill you easily."
"If you know that, why make pointless threats?"
"I said I wouldn't easily, didn't I? And even if I keep you alive, I can kill your sister, brothers, and the Black Knight without any problem. Wouldn't that be sad?"
"Then stop blabbering and try it."
"Right, Jin! Try it! If you can't even do it, just shut up!"
As Jin and Sandra spoke simultaneously, Jephyrin's lips twitched. The effort to maintain her composure and smile in the midst of boiling anger appeared as a convulsion.
A brief, chilling silence enveloped them.
The group knew that Jephyrin was exercising the utmost patience. In fact, she was considering just killing them all, command or not.
"You have a look in your eyes as if you're about to charge at any moment, Jephyrin."
Jin handed Yona to Murakan and slowly took out the blueprints and machine from his pocket. He then held one in each hand and gently shook them towards Jephyrin.
"You're staring so fiercely that I have no choice but to take these out."
"… Hand them over."
"It seems you still don't understand, huh? Huh? Don't move. If you keep threatening us, I don't know what will happen to these items that both of us went through so much trouble to obtain..."
Whoosh!
A sudden red flame erupted in Jin's left hand that was holding the blueprint. It was a flame formed by magic.
Jepirin froze like a statue, her eyes wide open, and the Runecandels reacted similarly.
What kind of items did they obtain!
"Stop it!"

"Rather, you should stop your clumsy threats, Jepirin. You said you're in a bad mood today? Same here. That's why I'm saying I might really throw all these things away. After the blueprint burns up, I won't hesitate for even a second to destroy the machine."
Whirling, crackling...!
That flame, which contained magic power of merely 3-star level, looked like a disaster to everyone who saw it. Of course, Sandra was once again secretly admiring it.
"Jin, Runecandel, you...!"
"To threaten someone, you have to do it like this, right? You came to us with a desperate attitude but you seem way too arrogant, don't you think, Jepirin?"
"If something goes wrong with those items, you will all die."
"I know that, okay? I'm just gambling here. Let's see who has a stronger hand."
Of course, the blueprint had been treated with protective magic.
However, the magic only protected a single sheet of paper, and with sensitive rune symbols written in various places, it would be irreversibly damaged in a few seconds if left like this.
Grasping at straws.
Jin's words were not wrong. Kinzelo and Jepirin also clearly knew from the beginning that the situation was unfavorable when they came to find them.
They just didn't expect Jin to be so tough.
To be precise, Bishukel and Marjiella anticipated it, but they sent Jepirin with a faint hope that Jin, who had been cornered by Gipul and Hedo all the time, would be off guard this time.
No, Jin didn't panic this time either and was fully utilizing the means he had.
"Turn it off!"
"I can't just turn it off."
"I won't attack, so turn it off now!"
Alright, it seems like it can be turned off now, little one. Hurry up. It's burning, it's burning!
The brothers thought the same as Jepirin. Jin didn't explain, but they almost perfectly understood the flow of the situation.
But Jin shook his head once more.
Joshua almost shouted to put out the fire at that point too.
"It's still not enough. There's one more condition."
"Ah, damn it, cursed, devilish bastard! What more do you want, huh!?"
Jin smirked and said:
"Jepirin, you and Kinzelo lost the gamble, so you have to pay the price."
"Tell me quickly!"
"Jepirin, until you leave the Lutero Magic Federation, you will escort Runecandel from Gipul. Agree, and I will put out the fire."
Before Jin even finished speaking, Jepirin was already vigorously nodding her head.
